title.zh: 丝绸之路：长安—天山走廊

summary.en: An overland network connected capital cities, oasis settlements, mountain passes, and religious centres. Goods moved through many hands, while travellers carried languages, beliefs, and practical knowledge. This layer follows selected parts of the corridor documented by UNESCO, rather than stretching one imaginary road from China to Europe. Branches around the Tianshan mountains explain why local geography mattered: deserts and passes shaped the available choices, while the importance of individual routes changed across centuries.
summary.zh: 陆路网络把都城、绿洲聚落、山口与宗教中心连接起来。货物经过多次转手，旅行者也传播语言、信仰和实用知识。本图层选择联合国教科文组织所记录走廊的一部分，而不是画出一条从中国直达欧洲的想象道路。天山两侧的分支说明地方地理为何重要：沙漠与山口影响路线选择，各段道路的重要性也随世纪而变化。

dateNote.en: Broad network window: 2nd century BCE to 16th century CE. Individual nodes have no single arrival year.
dateNote.zh: 广义网络时期为公元前2世纪至公元16世纪；各节点没有单一抵达年份。

caveat.en: Schematic connections, not surveyed ancient paths. Selected branches and many intermediate places are omitted; all nodes were not equally active at once.
caveat.zh: 连线为示意关系，并非测绘的古代道路。省略部分分支及许多中间地点，各节点也并非同时同等活跃。

title.en: Ports of the Indian Ocean world

summary.en: Ports connected the South China Sea with the Persian Gulf, Arabian Sea, and East African coast. This small selection follows connections identified in UNESCO’s account of Quanzhou. Exchange depended on many journeys and intermediate markets, not necessarily ships sailing directly from one displayed port to another. Merchants and resident communities carried objects, techniques, and religious practices across these waters. Comparing the ports invites questions about who organised trade, who translated, and how inland producers supported maritime life.
summary.zh: 港口把南海与波斯湾、阿拉伯海和东非海岸联系起来。这一小组选点依据联合国教科文组织对泉州交流关系的说明。交换依靠多次航程和中间市场，并不意味着船只总在两个显示港口之间直航。商人与侨居社区携带物品、技术和宗教实践跨越海域。比较这些港口，可以追问谁组织贸易、谁负责翻译，以及内陆生产者如何支持海上生活。

dateNote.en: Teaching focus c.800–1400; port histories and periods of prominence differ. Nodes are intentionally undated.

title.zh: 伊本·白图泰的首次朝觐

summary.en: A journey begun in Tangier became an education in the connected institutions of the Muslim world. Ibn Battuta travelled with caravans, received hospitality, met scholars, and sought routes protected by powerful states. His first pilgrimage reached Mecca in 1326 after passing through Egypt and Syria. The selected stops follow Berkeley ORIAS’s reconstruction from the Rihla and modern scholarship. The story also asks how a retrospective travel narrative differs from a diary written on the road.
summary.zh: 从丹吉尔出发的旅程，也成为认识穆斯林世界相互连接制度的学习过程。伊本·白图泰随商旅队前行，接受接待、会见学者，并寻找得到强大政权保护的道路。他经埃及和叙利亚，于1326年抵达麦加完成首次朝觐。选定节点依据伯克利ORIAS综合《游记》与现代研究的重建，同时引导我们区分事后整理的旅行叙事与旅途中的日记。

dateNote.en: 1325–1326; years follow the first-pilgrimage reconstruction. Many shorter stops and an unsuccessful Red Sea approach are omitted.
dateNote.zh: 1325—1326年；年份依据首次朝觐的重建，省略许多短暂停留及一次未成功的红海方向尝试。

title.en: The networks of Zheng He’s fleets

summary.en: Ming expeditions entered an already busy maritime world. Across seven expeditions, fleets and detached squadrons reached Southeast Asian ports, South Asia, the Persian Gulf, Arabia, and East Africa. Diplomacy, trade, tribute, and military intervention could occur together. The displayed connections combine selected stages from different expeditions. They show how a court projected power through ports and intermediaries, while leaving room to ask how local rulers, interpreters, merchants, and sailors shaped each encounter.
summary.zh: 明朝远航进入了一个早已繁忙的海上世界。七次远航中的船队与分队抵达东南亚港口、南亚、波斯湾、阿拉伯和东非。外交、贸易、朝贡与军事干预可能同时发生。这里的连接汇集不同航次的部分阶段，展示宫廷如何借助港口与中介投射权力，也引导我们思考地方统治者、翻译、商人和水手如何塑造每次相遇。

dateNote.en: Combined expeditions, 1405–1433. Undated nodes are not a single ship’s itinerary; the 1413–1415 and 1417–1419 extensions differ.
dateNote.zh: 汇集1405—1433年的远航。未设年份的节点不代表一艘船的单次行程；1413—1415与1417—1419年的延伸不同。

summary.en: Tupaia’s presence changes the meaning of this voyage. His expertise helped a British expedition navigate the Society Islands and communicate with Māori in Aotearoa. The ship entered inhabited worlds with their own histories, political interests, and ways of knowing the sea. His drawings and island chart preserve part of that encounter. The journey also involved violence and misunderstandings, and his ability to interpret Polynesian languages did not extend automatically to the languages of Australia.
summary.zh: 图帕亚的参与改变了这次航行的意义。他的知识帮助英国探险队在社会群岛航行，并在新西兰与毛利人交流。船只进入的是已有居民、历史、政治利益和海洋知识的世界。他的绘画与岛屿地图保存了相遇的一部分。航程也伴随暴力与误解，而他对波利尼西亚语言的理解，并不自动适用于澳大利亚的语言。

title.zh: 达尔文与“小猎犬号”：部分停靠地

summary.en: The Beagle voyage joined naval surveying with natural-history research. Darwin collected evidence from coastlines, islands, fossils, and living organisms, then spent years comparing what he had found. These selected landfalls reveal the geographical range behind that work, while the letters and notebooks show repeated visits, inland excursions, and the contribution of many other people. A line around the world cannot represent every day of the expedition, nor should the Galápagos visit be mistaken for an instant finished theory.
summary.zh: “小猎犬号”航行把海军测绘与博物研究结合起来。达尔文从海岸、岛屿、化石和生物中收集证据，随后多年比较研究。选定停靠地展示这些工作的地理范围，书信与笔记则记录重复访问、内陆考察及许多其他人的贡献。环绕世界的连线不能代表航行的每一天，也不应把加拉帕戈斯访问当成完整理论瞬间诞生的时刻。

title.zh: 横越大西洋的强迫迁移

summary.en: Enslavers forced people from many African societies into Atlantic crossings and labour regimes in the Americas. These movements were neither voluntary migration nor one uniform triangular route. Ships, merchants, and colonial institutions connected different regions over centuries, while captives resisted, maintained relationships, and created new communities under extreme coercion. The selected links illustrate regional relationships described by SlaveVoyages. They do not trace individual lives: a port of embarkation cannot tell us where a person was born, what language they spoke, or every journey that followed.
summary.zh: 奴隶贩运者强迫来自众多非洲社会的人们横越大西洋，进入美洲的强制劳动制度。这既不是自愿迁移，也不是一条统一的三角航线。数百年间，船只、商人和殖民制度把不同区域连接起来；被俘者在极端强制下抵抗、维系关系并建立新社区。选定连线展示SlaveVoyages所说明的区域关系，并不重建个人生平：启运港无法告诉我们一个人的出生地、语言或后续所有经历。

dateNote.en: Broad transatlantic period, 1501–1866. Nodes aggregate changing regional systems and intentionally have no single date.
dateNote.zh: 广义跨大西洋时期为1501—1866年。节点汇集不断变化的区域体系，故不设单一年份。

caveat.en: Regional anchors, not paired-port voyage claims. Schematic lines show selected relationships, not numbers, proportions, exact tracks, or the complete network. Embarkation regions are not birthplaces.

title.en: The Salt March: from Sabarmati to Dandi
title.zh: 食盐进军：从萨巴尔马蒂到丹地

summary.en: A walk made a colonial tax visible. Gandhi and fellow marchers left Sabarmati Ashram, spoke in towns and villages, and reached the coast at Dandi. Making salt there on 6 April challenged the British monopoly and helped widen civil disobedience. Speeches along the route show that the march involved sustained organising, persuasion, and practical cooperation. It was one part of a broader movement whose participants included people and places well beyond this line on the map.
summary.zh: 一场步行使殖民税制变得可见。甘地与同行者离开萨巴尔马蒂修院，在城镇和村庄演讲，最终抵达丹地海岸。4月6日在此制盐，挑战了英国的垄断，并推动更广泛的公民不服从。沿途演讲显示，这场进军需要持续组织、劝说与实际合作。它只是更大运动的一部分，参与者和活动地点远超地图上的这条线。

dateNote.en: 12 March–6 April 1930. Arrival at Dandi on 5 April preceded the salt-law action on 6 April; these are distinct events.
dateNote.zh: 1930年3月12日至4月6日。4月5日抵达丹地，4月6日采取违反食盐法的行动，两者应区分。

caveat.en: Selected documented stops and speeches, linked schematically. Intermediate villages, overnight halts and the actual walking path are omitted.
caveat.zh: 选定有记录的停留与演讲地点，以示意线连接；省略中间村庄、夜宿地与实际步行道路。

description.en: Departure on 12 March.
description.zh: 3月12日出发。

description.en: A speech linked the salt tax to village expenses.
description.zh: 演讲把盐税与村庄支出联系起来。

description.en: A documented public address during the march.
description.zh: 进军期间有记录的公开演讲。

description.en: Spoke and met volunteers.
description.zh: 演讲并会见志愿者。

description.en: Addressed a public meeting.
description.zh: 在公众集会上讲话。

description.en: A public address on 1 April.
description.zh: 4月1日公开演讲。

description.en: Arrived on 5 April; broke the salt law on 6 April.
description.zh: 4月5日抵达，4月6日打破食盐法。
